# Diagnostic codes: app area

Codes `APP-<TOPIC>-<NNN>` emitted by `src/core/src/app/` (owner: PDK,
`openspec/changes/m1-core-viewer/design.md` D2/D3). Conventions and the
renderings are described in [../codes.md](../codes.md).

The table below is generated from `src/core/src/app/codes.cpp`:

```sh
hefesto-cli --diagnostic-codes=app
```

The unit test `each area's code table matches its document and prefix`
fails when the two disagree.

<!-- BEGIN DIAGNOSTIC CODES (generated by `hefesto-cli --diagnostic-codes=app`) -->
| Code | Default severity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `APP-DISPLAY-001` | error | Unknown display type given with -d; startup fails with status 1. |
| `APP-FILE-001` | info | A file named on the command line is being loaded (`Loading "F" from command line.`; in wrapper mode `Handling file entry F extension E`). |
| `APP-FILE-002` | warning | A command-line file of this type (LEF, DEF, CIF, GDS, Tcl script) cannot be read in this release; it was skipped. |
| `APP-LIBPATH-001` | info | Standard-cell libraries of an open_pdks PDK were added to the library path (`Cell path is now "PATH"`). |
| `APP-OPTION-001` | error | Unknown command-line option (`Unknown option: '-X'`); startup fails with status 1. |
| `APP-OPTION-002` | error | An option argument starts with '-' (`Bad name after '-X' option`); startup fails with status 1. |
| `APP-OPTION-003` | error | Ambiguous `-n` option (use -nowindow, -noconsole or -norcfile); startup fails with status 1. |
| `APP-OPTION-004` | error | An option that needs an argument is the last word; startup fails with status 1. |
| `APP-PIN-001` | warning | The PDK version pinned by the project is not installed; the `minimum` technology is used until it is installed. |
| `APP-PROJECT-001` | error | The hefesto.project file is malformed. |
| `APP-PROJECT-002` | error | The hefesto.project file cannot be read or written. |
| `APP-QUIT-001` | warning | On iPadOS `quit` closed the project instead of ending the app (D-36): the script that called it stopped and the project browser is shown. |
| `APP-RECENT-001` | warning | The recent-projects list is malformed or unreadable; it is treated as empty. |
| `APP-RECOVER-001` | warning | Crash recovery (-r) is not available in this release; command-line files were not loaded. |
| `APP-SETTINGS-001` | warning | The user preferences file is malformed; the user settings layer is left empty. |
| `APP-STARTUP-001` | info | A startup file was found; its script commands run only once the Tcl binding exists (M4), its plain settings were applied. |
| `APP-STARTUP-002` | info | A deprecated startup file name (`~/.magic`, `.magic`) is in use. |
| `APP-TECH-001` | warning | The technology named at startup could not be loaded; the previous choice is kept. |
| `APP-TECH-002` | info | The technology chosen at startup (`Using technology "NAME"`). |
<!-- END DIAGNOSTIC CODES -->
